log: POCKETS FROM SPHERES, HINGES FROM SLOW MODES -- the chromatin machinery on candidate enzymes
The shortlist holds the true gene in its top-50 for 80.8% of obscure reactions but ranks it
first only 42.5% of the time, so ranking is the bottleneck. Sphere filling finds cavities
without a pose, and the slowest modes say which cavity is at a hinge, where active sites sit.
STATED BEFORE THE NUMBERS: with no substrate 3D structure this is a PER-PROTEIN prior, not a
pair score. It should down-rank non-enzymes and stay silent between two enzymes -- and 68.5%
of the ranking errors are enzyme-vs-enzyme. The EC-annotation arm is the control that decides
whether the physics beat a free lookup.
